title: New+ disables explorer's native rename function
summary: After creating a New+ template item, Explorer rename reportedly stops working.

judgment.rationale: The report gives an actionable scenario and supplied diagnostics, but the current failing boundary has not been established.
evidence: On 0.99.1 the reporter says creating a template file or folder causes Explorer F2 and context-menu rename to stop working even elsewhere.
A PowerToys report ZIP was supplied; the thread has no follow-up comments.
Inspected src/modules/NewPlus/NewShellExtensionContextMenu/template_item.cpp and new_utilities.h: New+ launches a worker to enter Explorer rename mode after copying.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce on a current build and identify the first failing stage before choosing a targeted correction.

fix_assessment.rationale: A targeted lifecycle correction may be applicable after the current failure is confirmed.

proposed_fixes.title: Investigate New+ interaction with Explorer rename
proposed_fixes.root_cause: New+ rename-mode or shell interaction may affect later Explorer rename, but the report does not establish that the presence of the created file is causal.
plan: Reproduce using a disposable folder and compare F2 and context-menu rename before and after New+ template creation.
Compare behavior after canceling the initial inline rename and after restarting Explorer to isolate shell state from file presence.
Trace the confirmed shell or worker interaction and coordinate with merged New+ rename changes before choosing a fix.
Add regression coverage that unrelated files can still be renamed after template creation.
verification: F2 and context-menu rename work for new and existing items after New+ use.
Template creation, initial inline rename and desktop positioning continue to work.

confidence.rationale: The reported scenario is concrete but the current-build behavior and failing stage remain unknown.

reproduce.title: Investigate New+ interaction with Explorer rename
reproduce.version_requirement: Use the current PowerToys release and compare the reported version if practical.
prerequisites: Use a Windows test machine and preserve the original configuration.
setup: Use a disposable local folder with an ordinary file and a simple New+ file and folder template.
steps: 1. Verify F2 and context-menu rename on an existing file in Explorer.
2. Create a file using New+ and finish or cancel its initial inline rename.
3. Try both rename methods on the created file and an unrelated existing file in another folder.
4. Repeat with a folder template, then restart Explorer as a control and retry.
reproduce.expected_result: Explorer rename works normally for both new and unrelated items after creating a template.
